### SetupModule {#SetupModule}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">setup.SetupModule</code></div>

The setup module bound to a client context (presets use the client chain).

```ts sdk-signature
interface SetupModule {
  prepareCreateOvm: (
    input: CreateOvmInput,
  ) => Promise<Prepared<'createOvm'>>;
  prepareOvmWithSplits: (
    input: OvmWithSplitsInput,
  ) => Promise<Prepared<'ovmWithSplits'>>;
  ovmFromReceipt: (
    receipt: Parameters<typeof ovmFromReceipt>[0],
  ) => OvmCreated;
  ovmSplitParams: (
    input: Preset<typeof ovmSplitParams>,
  ) => ReturnType<typeof ovmSplitParams>;
  rewardsSplit: (
    input: Preset<typeof rewardsSplit>,
  ) => OvmWithSplitsInput;
  totalSplit: (
    input: Preset<typeof totalSplit>,
  ) => OvmWithSplitsInput;
  solo: (input: Preset<typeof solo>) => OvmWithSplitsInput;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>prepareCreateOvm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: <a href="#CreateOvmInput">CreateOvmInput</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'createOvm'&gt;&gt;</span> | Deploys an OVM through the Obol factory with the given owner, recipients and principal threshold (default 16 ETH). The address is known after mining: `ovmFromReceipt`. A recipient with no code: RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT (info). |
| <code>prepareOvmWithSplits</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: <a href="#OvmWithSplitsInput">OvmWithSplitsInput</a>, ) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="./send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'ovmWithSplits'&gt;&gt;</span> | Deploys an OVM and the splits behind its recipients in one transaction (Multicall3), reusing splits that exist (SPLIT_REUSED). Build the input with `rewardsSplit`, `totalSplit` or `solo`. Each send creates a new OVM: after an unknown outcome, look for the earlier `CreateObolValidatorManager` event before retrying. |
| <code>ovmFromReceipt</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(receipt: Parameters&lt;typeof ovmFromReceipt&gt;[0]) =&gt; <a href="#OvmCreated">OvmCreated</a></span> |  |
| <code>ovmSplitParams</code> | <span class="sdk-type">( input: Preset&lt;typeof ovmSplitParams&gt;, ) =&gt; ReturnType&lt;typeof ovmSplitParams&gt;</span> |  |
| <code>rewardsSplit</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: Preset&lt;typeof rewardsSplit&gt;) =&gt; <a href="#OvmWithSplitsInput">OvmWithSplitsInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>totalSplit</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: Preset&lt;typeof totalSplit&gt;) =&gt; <a href="#OvmWithSplitsInput">OvmWithSplitsInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>solo</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input: Preset&lt;typeof solo&gt;) =&gt; <a href="#OvmWithSplitsInput">OvmWithSplitsInput</a></span> |  |

</div>
